description:
List captured HTTP requests from React Native JavaScript or the active Chromium tab. Use when you need to find a request or compare several calls. For native traffic, use native-network-logs.
Returns a paginated list with request IDs, status, size and timing. Pass an ID to view-network-request-details for headers and bodies.
On iOS simulators and Android, call network-capture-start before the action and again after a reload. On Vega, read this log before the action and again after a reload to resume capture. Chromium records while Argent is attached to the page.
Fails if the Chromium target is unreachable. A read can also fail if Argent cannot reach the debugger for an existing JS capture. If the tool returns a capture message in place of a list, follow it before retrying.

device_id.description: Device ID from list-devices. For iOS simulators and Android, use logicalDeviceId if capture started with it.

pageIndex.description: Zero-based page index. "latest" and null select the newest page. Each page contains up to 50 entries. Default: "latest".

port.description: Metro port. Omit it to use this device's port (8081 by default). Ignored for Chromium, whose CDP port is in device_id. Range: 1 to 65535.

name: view-network-logs
